title: Exact Diffusion Design for Maximally Collective Stable Turing Patterns in Binary-Complex Mass-Action Networks
additional_title: Topology-Wide All-Spectrum Localization and Exponent-Optimal Stationary Heterogeneity Trade-Offs
description: For every n ≥ 4, this preprint constructs an n-species binary-complex classical mass-action topology for which, throughout every positive-equilibrium realization, every principal subsystem below order n − 1 is Hurwitz while one order-(n − 1) subsystem is unstable. A general principal-minor diffusion-ray theorem yields an exact necessary-and-sufficient stationary diffusion law. Exact rational designs give primary supercritical bifurcations with locally exponentially stable positive patterns, and an equilibrium-scaled family realizes topology-specific stationary heterogeneity contrasts of order √n. The networks are synthetic; nonlinear conclusions are local for each fixed dimension, and arbitrary wave instability is outside the stationary law. Version 1.0.11 includes the preprint, supplement, TeX source, portable exact-verification repository, and data archive. This author preprint has not undergone journal peer review.
